correctness.rationale: Best response max(0,q-neighbor sum) follows from strict concavity and monotone benefit. At positive vertex local 3-effort sum=q; all-positive subtraction forces x_{i+3}=x_i. With zeros, positive and zero runs cannot exceed length two; two-zero gaps force singleton q endpoints, and a one-zero D-D gap forces next D parameter >= previous. Both directions of block-equilibrium correspondence were checked. With s singleton blocks, t double blocks, r doubled gaps, n=2s+3t+r; if mixed s,t, r<=s-1, yielding the stated sharp t by residue n mod3, with all-positive dimension 2 at multiples of3. Independent support-stratum linear feasibility/dimension checks n=3..10 passed; these do not extend the proof.
